episode_event_academy_2026summer/4001_10:
What’s wrong? Got a stomachache from
eating something weird?
Um... Who do you think Juliana IS, Sis?

I found so many things to do at Pasio
Academy...

I’m taking so many classes that my
assignments are really piling up.

And it’s been so warm lately, I can’t seem
to stay focused. I’m falling behind!
Yeah, it’s been pretty tough lately.

Really? Even you struggle with homework,
Juliana?

That’s when you know it’s time to take a
breather.

There’s room in life to take the scenic path
sometimes, yeah? It’s hard to stay motivated
without some fun.
episode_event_academy_2026summer/6801_10:
At festivals, whoever has the most fun wins!
Are you ready?
Of course! We’ll enjoy it to the fullest!
I think we’re all gonna be winners today!
episode_event_academy_2026summer/4002_10:
There’s room in life to take the scenic path
sometimes, yeah? It’s hard to stay motivated
without some fun.

Oh, please. I don’t wanna hear it from you.
You’re ALWAYS slacking.
I’m not talkin’ about me.

Hey, bud. What’s something you look
forward to when it’s hot out?
Well...

Come to think of it, it was around this time
of year that I went to that festival in
Kitakami. It was hot then!
Carmine, Kieran, and I wore jinbei.

Yeah! We competed for the highest
Ogre Oustin’ score.

We did all sorts of other things, too. I ate
candy apples with Juliana.

You’re talking about the Festival of Masks,
right?

Back in my world, I went to that with
Carmine and Kieran, too...
A festival, eh? Sounds fun!
Couldn’t we get the academy to host one?

Are you saying you’d be willing to
organize it?
Naaah. I’m an ideas guy.

Go ahead and assign whatever tasks you
need to the right folks.
You’re too lazy to do it yourself, then.
Heh heh! Yup! You know me well!
Sheesh...

Fine. I’ll bring it up to Lacey and make sure
it happens.
Oh?
Really, Carmine?
We’ll never get this rolling otherwise, right?

In return, you’d better do your share at the
festival, Drayton!
Yeah, yeah.

Juliana, Kiki, you need to finish your
homework by the day of the festival!
Ugh... That part’s still a drag.

But Drayton was right! Now that we’ve got
something to look forward to, I’m motivated
to study!

I can help with your assignments. Let’s work
together!
episode_event_academy_2026summer/4003_10: But...why are you in your school uniforms?!

Well... Koraidon napped on my jinbei, so it’s
wrinkled and covered in drool.

Same for me. Before I knew it, mine was
covered in Hydrapple’s syrup.
Sheesh. You two weren’t careful enough!
Oh well. Nothing we can do about it now.
Let’s switch gears and have fun, shall we?
episode_event_academy_2026summer/4004_10:
Going to a festival with Carmine and Kieran
reminds me of my school trip to Kitakami!
Me too!
Let’s make a bunch of new memories!

How lucky for you! It’s your SECOND time
going to a festival with a pretty girl in
a jinbei!

I’m glad we got to come to another festival
with Juliana.

Hey, Florian. If you’ve been to a festival in
Kitakami...

I gotta see if you’re any good at
Ogre Oustin’!
Ogre Oustin’...
They have that here?

As the festival’s organizer, I added an event
similar to Ogre Oustin’!
And the one I put in charge of it is...

She was all demanding about it, and
recreating it was a real challenge...
You put it together?

That’s amazing! It must’ve been a lot
of work!
Ehehe... I did my best. I hope you like it!
Here’s the sign-up for Ogre Oustin’.
Ah, you made it!

I’ve been looking after Drayton to make sure
he doesn’t slack off!

You assigned me a babysitter, Carmine?
Not fair!

You’re the one who said I should assign
tasks to the right folks.

The festival was YOUR idea, so don’t make
everyone else do all the work! That’s just
not right!

C’mon, buddy. Do something about them,
would ya?
Don’t ask me—I couldn’t even if I tried!
Hehe! Off to work you go!
Are you gonna give it a try?
Of course!

You may already know the rules, but we’ll
explain just in case.
Take it away, Drayton!
Why me?

If you know the rules, you don’t need ME
to explain ’em!
Just do it, would you?
Yeah, yeah, OK. Stop with the scary face.
OK, here are the rules!

...So in short, you’re working with your
partner Pokémon to pop the most balloons.

Carmine’s folks worked hard to set this up,
so enjoy it.

Thanks for the rundown! See what you can
do when you put your mind to it?
If only he could STAY motivated...
OK, Florian! You’re up first—against me!
I accept your challenge!
Yanmega, huh? I figured you’d use Miraidon.

I did use Miraidon for the Festival of Masks’
Ogre Oustin’...

but while I’m on Pasio, I wanna make new
memories!

Our speed and power won’t lose to your
Mightyena!

Heh heh...interesting! Then I’ll show you
what real talent looks like!
Good luck, you two!
You got this! Aim for a high score!

OK, let’s get started and make sure everyone
enjoys the festival!
episode_event_academy_2026summer/4005_10: I’ll get us fried noodles! My treat!

Carmine’s more pumped up than usual
today, huh?
She must’ve been looking forward to this.
That’s true, but...

I think Big Sis is happy she achieved
her goal.
Her goal?
Please don’t tell her this came from me...

While she DID want Juliana and the rest
of us to take a break and de-stress...
this festival was mainly for you, Florian.
For me?

’Cause you haven’t had a chance to enjoy
a Kitakami festival with us in our world,
you know?

She wanted to host a similar festival so you
could make memories with us!
I wanted to go to a festival with you, too.
Really? I’m happy to hear that!
Sorry to keep you waiting!
Carmine! Thanks a bunch!

Wow, you REALLY wanted those fried
noodles, huh?

I’ve learned something important from you,
Carmine.

If you don’t have memories with a friend yet,
you can make them!
Kiki... You spilled the beans, didn’t you.
W-wowzers...

I’ve started brainstorming ideas for more fun
stuff we could do.
I’m even more excited about what’s to come!

You’d better bring your best ideas if you’re
competing with MY festival!

I’m gonna do my best in everything—from
lessons to events!

If you go all out, won’t you end up in the
same pickle all over again?
Oops, you’re right! I promise I’ll take it easy!
